body:
Step 7(a) independently reproduces this existing defect on the current branch based on main `61ff4ed4789e61ef64f6f75a792adf3b934e7c82`.

The native assembler binds corrected owner hashes but rows 9 (`02_Thiamine_Pyrophosphate`), 652 (`Casamino_Acids`) and 654 (`Casein`) still describe the removed `kg_microbe_node_id` fields as present. Receipt 22 proves the source transitions. All three dispositions are still WITHHOLD; no unsupported mapping has been released.

Before the fix, the bounded decision is to preserve the archived concern text and qualify it as historical when the verified owner or row receipt proves it predates the current payload. Current output must retain WITHHOLD and explicitly leave all other stock, identity, alias, role and preparation concerns unresolved. The change must not retire historical findings or grant scientific approval. Implement this in the assembler with regression tests and regenerate the downstream review/export chain. No source writer, historical receipt, unified snapshot or approval policy will change.

Independent reproduction SHA256: `0b0d6c7e6f83c4fe1cef734599e1f6711e6fc594ee56370a003ec13bf9691362`; native log SHA256: `42dcca0b34ca3b8c30cfc74d8d3b65f1adb4b9c7fe8f4b8958f58ee3127d92b1`. This is a bounded application of #902; wider historical reconciliation remains open.
